   187	/**
   188	 * Lists all declared repositories from the registry file, and optionally
   189	 * includes undeclared namespace directories discovered on the filesystem.
   190	 *
   191	 * When `includeUndeclared` is `false` (the default), behavior is identical to
   192	 * the original implementation — only declared repos are returned.
   193	 *
   194	 * When `includeUndeclared` is `true`, the function performs a `readdir` at the
   195	 * ledger root, collects namespace directories that are not already covered by
   196	 * any declared repo's `folder_names`, validates each undeclared namespace
   197	 * contains at least one project (via `LedgerStore.listProjectsByFolderNames`),
   198	 * and returns them as synthetic `RepoListItem` entries with `declared: false`.
   199	 *
   200	 * Dot-prefixed directories are always excluded (archive/control directories).
   201	 *
   202	 * @param ledgerRoot        - Absolute path to the centralized ledger root directory.
   203	 * @param includeUndeclared - When true, also returns filesystem-discovered namespaces.
   204	 *                            Defaults to false to preserve existing behavior.
   205	 */
   206	export async function handleListRepos(
   207	  ledgerRoot: string,
   208	  includeUndeclared = false
   209	): Promise<RepoListItem[]> {
   210	  const registry = await loadRegistry(ledgerRoot);
   211	  const declared = registry.repositories.map(toListItem);
   212	
   213	  if (!includeUndeclared) {
   214	    return declared;
   215	  }
   216	
   217	  // Collect all folder_names already claimed by declared entries
   218	  const declaredFolderNames = new Set<string>(
   219	    registry.repositories.flatMap((e) => e.folder_names)
   220	  );
   221	
   222	  // Enumerate namespace directories at the ledger root
   223	  let dirents: import('fs').Dirent[];
   224	  try {
   225	    dirents = await readdir(ledgerRoot, { withFileTypes: true });
   226	  } catch {
   227	    // Ledger root unreadable — return just the declared repos
   228	    return declared;
   229	  }
   230	
   231	  // Find directories not covered by any declared repo's folder_names
   232	  const undeclaredNamespaces = dirents
   233	    .filter((d) => d.isDirectory() && !d.name.startsWith('.') && !declaredFolderNames.has(d.name))
   234	    .map((d) => d.name);
   235	
   236	  if (undeclaredNamespaces.length === 0) {
   237	    return declared;
   238	  }
   239	
   240	  // Validate undeclared namespaces contain at least one project to avoid surfacing
   241	  // empty or control directories
   242	  const undeclaredItems: RepoListItem[] = [];
   243	  for (const namespace of undeclaredNamespaces) {
   244	    const projects = await LedgerStore.listProjectsByFolderNames([namespace], ledgerRoot);
   245	    if (projects.length === 0) {
   246	      continue; // Skip empty/non-project directories
   247	    }
   248	    const now = new Date().toISOString();
   249	    undeclaredItems.push({
   250	      id: namespace,
   251	      label: namespace,
   252	      folder_names: [namespace],
   253	      has_vision: false,
   254	      has_full_vision: false,
   255	      created_at: now,
   256	      last_modified: now,
   257	      declared: false,
   258	    });
   259	  }
   260	
   261	  return [...declared, ...undeclaredItems];
   262	}

   275	export async function handleGetRepo(

   277	  repoId: string
